facts.fact: African ministers in charge of telecoms, ICT and digital economy adopted the Algiers Declaration on fair, safe and responsible digital platforms at Algiers on 6-8 December 2025, drafted under the African Telecommunications Union, with Algeria's ICT minister speaking for it; it is to go to the African Union for adoption.
